g.text: Raspberry Pi Pico · 16 Pads · 7 Control Buttons · OLED SSD1306
Each button will have one of the pins connected to a Pico port
All GNDS are connected to each other

text.tspan: All buttons and pads use INPUT_PULLUP — without external resistors needed. Power: USB 5V via cable. OLED: 3V3 from Pico.
